results: 1. awareness and recall during the event: awareness recovers between seizures - this is not status epilepticus
2. interictal EEG: runs of generalized polyspikes and spike-wave discharges at 2-3 Hz lasting 3-4 s, predominating bifrontally and occasionally shifting laterally

3. video-EEG monitoring of a typical event: ictal BODY TURNING, often preceded by head version, but the EEG shows classic GENERALIZED spike-wave or polyspike discharges WITHOUT consistent lateralization
